affected_party: Organizations using QIF portable trust policy governance
actual_problem: A promoted policy can drift from its approved state without a durable comparison, and emergency demotion can occur without an auditable authority and evidence chain.
why_it_matters: Undetected drift can silently invalidate prior quality decisions while an ungoverned demotion can create a second uncontrolled state change.
why_now: QIF v0.8.8 now reconciles activation and recovery, so the next unresolved lifecycle boundary is post-promotion drift and emergency response.
